notes.title: “Greetings, you who are highly favored”
notes.intro: The angel’s greeting to Mary (translated “full of grace” in older versions) is a key text for teaching about Mary.

views.label: Mary was uniquely filled with grace from her conception
views.summary: Catholics read the greeting (Greek kecharitōmenē) as pointing to Mary’s being preserved from sin from the first moment of her existence (the Immaculate Conception).

views.label: Mary was all-holy, prepared by God to be the Theotokos
views.summary: Orthodox Christians call Mary “all-holy” and “full of grace,” without the Catholic definition of the Immaculate Conception.
views.source: Orthodox Akathist Hymn to the Theotokos

views.label: Mary received God’s favour for her calling
views.summary: Most Protestants read the word as Mary being greatly favoured by God’s grace for her role, without further doctrines.
